label: [ PassOff 105 ]

blocks.text: After my sophomore year, I took a leave of absence from my studies and got a part-time job for six months before I started my military service.
My military service was a hard time in my life, but I learned a lot.
During this time, I developed patience and an understanding of how important my family was.
After my military service was completed, I returned to my studies once again.
